title: [Cobblemon] Nobinyobi Addon!
description: Adds the Generation 3 scrapped Pokémon, Nobinyobi, into Cobblemon as a custom FakeMon!
body:
**_WARNING: This datapack needs base Cobblemon to work._**

**Nobinyobi** is a beta version of Baltoy, found within the source of Pokémon Ruby And Sapphire.

This Datapack & Resourcepack aims to add Nobinyobi as a custom Pokémon for Cobblemon, alongside with a custom signature move, Rocky Leafstorm!

Nobinyobi spawns in the same areas as Baltoy, in Badlands and Deserts below Y=0 and everywhere in the Overworld below Y=48.

# Installation

- Download the datapack
- Go to the three dots on your modpack, near the Play button and click Open Folder.
- Find V10 Nobinyobi.zip and copy it.
- For a resource pack, paste it into the "resourcepacks" folder.
- To add it to a world, go to the "saves" folder, into your world's folder and paste it in the "datapacks" folder present within.
